name: whatsapp-web-js-client-for-postintime
description: WhatsApp client (whatsapp-web.js) that receives postintime webhook calls and posts them to a WhatsApp channel

scripts.preinstall: node -e "if (!/pnpm/.test(process.env.npm_execpath || '')) { console.error('\nThis project uses pnpm. Run: pnpm install\n'); process.exit(1); }"
